title: Frontend Developer (Accessibility Specialist)
description: We are seeking a Frontend Developer dedicated to building highly accessible, WCAG 2.1 AA compliant Web Applications. You will work closely with visual accessibility tools, voice dictation APIs, and screen readers.
requirements: Strong foundation in React, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, ARIA live regions, keyboard navigation patterns, and automated accessibility auditing tools.
responsibilities: Design and build semantic React components, audit UI accessibility, ensure voice input capability, and collaborate with UX researchers.
accessibilityInformation: Fully screen-reader compatible codebase, flexible working hours, voice dictation tooling provided, remote work support.

responsibilities: Develop secure backend APIs, optimize database operations, collaborate with frontend teams, and implement screen-reader friendly APIs.

title: UI/UX Accessibility Designer

responsibilities: Create accessible design tokens, conduct low-vision user testing, design voice interaction flows, and maintain component styleguides.
experience: 2+ years of UI/UX product design experience
accessibilityInformation: Remote-first culture, flexible hours, screen reader audio equipment allowance, dedicated accessibility mentors.

title: AI & Voice Systems Engineer
